ScienceGears | Your Trusted Scientific Equipment Supplier

>ScienceGears is a scientific equipment supplier in Australia and New Zealand, specializing in high-performance electrochemistry and spectroscopy instruments. They offer a wide range of products including potentiostats, battery cyclers, and spectroscopy tools like Raman spectrometers and LIBS analyzers. The company emphasizes scientific excellence, innovative solutions, and dedicated support, providing tailored technical assistance to researchers. Their offerings cater to various applications in energy storage, electrocatalysis, and chemical analysis. ScienceGears collaborates with leading global manufacturers to ensure access to advanced technologies and reliable service.


[+61 493 868 335](tel:+61 493 868 335)info@sciencegears.com.au

# Integrated Electrochemistry & Spectroscopy Solutions for Advanced Research

## Empowering Scientific Innovation Across Australia & New Zealand

At ScienceGears, we are a trusted **scientific equipment supplier** in Australia and New Zealand, providing high-performance **electrochemistry and spectroscopy instruments** trusted by researchers in universities, industry, and government laboratories. Our team of PhD-trained scientists brings practical expertise and tailored technical support to empower advanced research with precision instruments and comprehensive guidance. Discover premium all-in-one electrochemical and spectroscopy solutions designed to meet your evolving scientific needs, backed by expert consultation and comprehensive supply support.

We offer a complete range of **electrochemical systems**, including **potentiostats**, **battery cyclers**, **bipotentiostats**, **and accessories** such as rotating ring-disk electrodes (RRDE), corrosion cells, PEM/AEM electrolyser cells, and fuel cell kits—ideal for applications in energy storage, electrocatalysis, corrosion testing, and chemical sensor development.

Our **spectroscopy portfolio** features **Raman spectrometers** (785 nm and 1064 nm), **Mid-Infrared (MIR) analysers**, and **LIBS elemental analysers**, enabling fast, non-destructive analysis for chemical identification, microplastics detection, pharmaceutical quality control, mineral composition analysis, and real-time process monitoring.

![Integrated Electrochemistry & Spectroscopy Solutions for Advanced Research](https://res.cloudinary.com/dbniglyrl/image/upload/c_fill,g_auto/v1752501763/products/1752501761282-Home_page_Siva_1.jpg)

#### Scientific Excellence

Our team comprises experienced scientists who understand the real-world challenges of electrochemical and spectroscopic research. We speak your language—because we’ve worked in the lab too.

#### Innovative Solutions

We offer innovative instrumentation that goes beyond technical specifications - enabling custom setups, integrated analysis, and modular upgrades to fit your evolving research needs.

#### Dedicated Support

From the moment you enquire, our experts work with you to identify the most suitable instruments and accessories tailored to your specific research goals. We engage in scientific discussions to help you make informed decisions. Following installation, we provide hands-on training and continue to offer reliable, long-term technical support, ensuring you're fully supported throughout your research journey.
